summary: TrueConf is a self-hosted corporate communication platform that provides video conferencing and built-in messaging for teams. It supports UltraHD video quality and offers a free tier accommodating up to 1000 users.
goodFor: Organisations looking for an on-premises video conferencing and instant messaging infrastructure with a large user capacity on the free tier.
watchOut: The software is proprietary, meaning you cannot inspect or modify the source code, and public metrics indicate limited visibility into community development activity.
deployNotes: You can deploy this using Docker or standard deb packages, which typically requires configuring persistent storage volumes for chat history and setting up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
